summary: Retire church.ekodi.kr and lab.ekodi.kr as EKODI-owned public/service domains and move all supported public verification to https://ekodi.kr/ekodichurch and https://ekodi.kr/ekodilab.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly required all legacy EKODI subdomains to be removed rather than retained as redirects and instructed EKODI collaboration to continue through completion.
migrationPolicy: Remove Worker custom-domain routes and Pages custom-domain bindings for church.ekodi.kr and lab.ekodi.kr, stop workflows from recreating them, move deployment/watch/load/core verification to apex paths, and point external legacy-domain redirects directly to apex paths.
rollbackPlan: If apex-path production verification fails, restore the previous route/config commit and guarded Worker/Pages bindings from version control before retrying retirement.
